_readme: This file tells the library WHERE to load .proto files from when you run: ./gradlew syncProtos. JSON cannot use // comments, so fields starting with _ are documentation only (ignored by the tool).
_source: Choose how protos are loaded: "local" = folder on disk, "github" = clone a git repo, "buf" = Buf Schema Registry.
_path: Used when source is "local". Folder that contains your .proto files (relative to the repo root).
_repo: Used when source is "github". Full git URL of the proto repository. Set to null when using local.
_ref: Used when source is "github". Pin a tag or commit (example: "v1.2.3"). Do not use a moving branch for releases. Set to null when using local.
_out: Optional. Where generated client files are written (relative to the kmp-proto module).
